physics-h2-q2.title: Sharciyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee Newton iyo aragtida isku-xidhnaanta gaarka ah
physics-h2-q2.topic: Sharciyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee Newton iyo aragtida isku-xidhnaanta gaarka ah
physics-h2-q2.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-h2-q2.material: Shay A oo cufnaantiisu tahay 3 kg iyo shay B oo cufnaantiisu tahay 2 kg ayaa la dhigay isku xidhan dusha jiifka ah ee aan marayn, xoog jiif ah oo 20 N ah ayaana la dabaqay si loo riixo dhinaca A. Waa maxay dardargelinta labada shay iyo cabbirka xoogga A uu ku riixayo B, siday u kala horreeyaan?
physics-h2-q2.thinking.0: Sharciyada dhaqdhaqaaqa ee Newton iyo aragtida isku-xidhnaanta gaarka ah
physics-h2-q2.s.s1.prompt: Shay A oo cufnaantiisu tahay 3 kg iyo shay B oo cufnaantiisu tahay 2 kg ayaa la dhigay isku xidhan dusha jiifka ah ee aan marayn, xoog jiif ah oo 20 N ah ayaana la dabaqay si loo riixo dhinaca A. Waa maxay dardargelinta labada shay iyo cabbirka xoogga A uu ku riixayo B, siday u kala horreeyaan?
physics-h2-q2.s.s1.explain: Dardargelinta guud waa $a = \frac{F}{m_A + m_B} = \frac{20\text{ N}}{5\text{ kg}} = 4\text{ m/s}^2$. Xoogga guud ee kaliya ee dardargelinaya shayga B waa xoogga taabashada ee A ku riixayo B, sidaas darteed $F_{AB} = m_B \cdot a = 2\text{ kg} \times 4\text{ m/s}^2 = 8\text{ N}$.

physics-h2-c.material: [Induction-ka korontada-magnetiga ee sare] Marka magnet loo soo dhoweeyo coil, emf la sababay ayaa soo baxda (sharciga Faraday iyo sharciga Lenz). physics-killer-11.title: Saamaynta photoelectric, laba-geesoodka iftiinka iyo adduunka yar-yar
physics-killer-11.topic: Saamaynta photoelectric, laba-geesoodka iftiinka iyo adduunka yar-yar
physics-killer-11.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-11.material: Walax P ayaa gasha goob magnetic isku mid ah $B$ si toosan goobta wuxuuna sameeyaa dhaqdhaqaaq goobaabin joogto ah oo radius wareeg ah $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ iyo muddo $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Walax Q ayaa gasha isla goobta si toosan, cufnaanteeduna waa $4$ jeer tii P, cabbirka dallaaddeeduna waa $2$ jeer tii P, xawaarahuna waa $3$ jeer kii P. Iska dhaaf cuf-jiidadka. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, radius-ka wareegga iyo muddada Q?
physics-killer-11.thinking.0: Saamaynta photoelectric, laba-geesoodka iftiinka iyo adduunka yar-yar
physics-killer-11.s.s1.prompt: Walax P ayaa gasha goob magnetic isku mid ah $B$ si toosan goobta wuxuuna sameeyaa dhaqdhaqaaq goobaabin joogto ah oo radius wareeg ah $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ iyo muddo $2\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Walax Q ayaa gasha isla goobta si toosan, cufnaanteeduna waa $4$ jeer tii P, cabbirka dallaaddeeduna waa $2$ jeer tii P, xawaarahuna waa $3$ jeer kii P. Iska dhaaf cuf-jiidadka. Doodee ayaa si sax ah u bixisa, si kala horreeya, radius-ka wareegga iyo muddada Q?
physics-killer-11.s.s1.explain: Maadaama $r\propto\dfrac{mv}{q}$, $\dfrac{r_Q}{r_P}=\dfrac{4m\cdot3v}{2q}\cdot\dfrac{q}{mv}=6\Rightarrow r_Q=5\times6=30\,\mathrm{cm}$. $T=\dfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$ kuma tiirsana xawaaraha, sidaas darteed $\dfrac{T_Q}{T_P}=\dfrac{4}{2}=2\Rightarrow T_Q=4\,\mu\mathrm{s}$. Ilaawidda saamiga dallaadda waxay bixisaa $r=60\,\mathrm{cm}$, $T=8\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (doodda 1); u qaadashada muddada inay la jaanqaadayso xawaaraha waxay bixisaa $12\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ (doodda 3); iska indho tirka labada saamiga cufnaanta iyo dallaadda oo isticmaalka saamiga xawaaraha oo keliya waxay bixisaa $r=15\,\mathrm{cm}$ (doodda 4).
physics-killer-11.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-11.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
